exposure: Specific antepartum diagnoses (e.g., threatened abortion, urinary tract infection, hemorrhage, preterm labor, pyelonephritis, hyperemesis gravidarum)
outcome: Delivery complications (defined as severe maternal morbidity, vaginal or cesarean delivery complications, or long length of stay after delivery)
cohort: 348,848 individuals with live births in California in 2017
finding: Antepartum hospital use, particularly inpatient hospitalizations, was associated with an increased likelihood of delivery complications, even after controlling for pre-existing conditions.
